turns.question: Do we sell more at weekends? Between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, what was our average daily revenue on Saturdays and Sundays, and on the other days?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric (the closest are revenue_eur, Revenue (EUR), and revenue_eur_wow_growth), so I will not compute an average myself; what it does give is total revenue by weekday for 17 August to 27 September 2026: Monday 2,340.75 EUR, Tuesday 2,301.25 EUR, Wednesday 2,329.25 EUR, Thursday 2,383.25 EUR, Friday 2,221.75 EUR, Saturday 2,252.75 EUR, Sunday 2,423.75 EUR, so Saturday is not above the weekday totals while Sunday is the highest. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
